aboutThisItem: ☆Multiple Ways to Wear☆ Our pashmina shawls offer generous coverage, draping over your shoulders to provide warmth and comfort. Whether you need to stay cozy during a cool evening or simply want to add a stylish layer to your outfit. Wear in a variety of styles: long, knotted, looped, twisted, capes, poncho, wrap, pashmina or doubled around the neck. Measures approximately 74” x 29” including fringe 3.5”. Made from 100% Viscose – even if the tag says otherwise.

☆Soft Shawl☆ Versatile wrap that goes with any outfit - dress it up with a black dress or dress it down with a pair of jeans. Can be worn whether you're running errands, attending a meeting, or enjoying a night out. Has a soft and silky feel that keeps you comfortable while wearing.

☆Wedding Accessory☆ Our pashmina shawls are versatile enough to complement the attire of brides, bridesmaids, and wedding guests alike. Whether draped over your shoulders during the ceremony or used as cover-ups during outdoor receptions, they enhance the wedding experience and provide both warmth and style to the bridal party while remaining lightweight.
☆How to Wash☆ Hand wash the shawl in lukewarm water using delicate detergent then air dry.
☆Give as a Gift☆ These shawl wraps for women can be a gift for any occasion: Christmas shawl, Valentine's Day, Birthday, Mother’s Day, Prom or Weddings.
